title: Payment Capture and Order-Level Refunds for Online Orders
content:
## Capture

**P1.** The tenders of an Online Orders order are authorized at placement and captured at dispatch, drawn in the order's capture order of tenders. Each tender captured is recorded once per instrument, dated with the dispatch date.

**P2.** A card authorization older than the authorization validity period is renewed before capture, and a declined renewal cancels the unshipped lines with reason payment failure.

## Order-level refunds

**P3.** Order-level refunds (price adjustments, late promotion codes, shipping fee refunds and undelivered orders) go back only to tenders captured on the same order, in the order's refund order of tenders, never more to a tender than was captured from it.

**P4.** A stored-value tender is refunded to the same instrument even if it has since expired or been used up.

**P5.** A refund is never paid to a different card, in cash, or to a new gift card.

**P6.** Refunds of returned merchandise are governed by Returns & Exchanges.

On the order's payment records, an order-level refund carries one of these components: price adjustment, promotion adjustment (a late code), shipping fee, undelivered order, or delivery claim (a refund decided under Delivery Claims).

## Where an order-level refund can and cannot go

| Destination | Allowed |
|---|---|
| A tender captured on the same order, up to what was captured from it | Yes |
| The same stored-value instrument, now expired | Yes |
| The same stored-value instrument, now used up | Yes |
| A different card | Never |
| Cash | Never |
| A new gift card | Never |
| A tender captured on another order | No |

## Worked refund (hypothetical order)

An order captured 15.00 from the customer's card and 100.00 from a gift card. A price adjustment of 30.00 is refunded. The refund order of tenders puts the card or digital wallet first and the gift card second; the card can take back no more than its 15.00, so 15.00 goes to the card and the remaining 15.00 to the gift card.

If the gift card has since expired or been spent down to nothing, its 15.00 still goes back to that same gift card.
